profile.name: Tommy Reardon
profile.title: Robotics Engineer
profile.bio: I'm an engineer driven by a passion for bringing ideas to life — from early concept through to a finished, market-ready product. With a background in Robotics Engineering, I thrive in hands-on environments where I can design, build, and iterate on real physical systems.

experience.description: Leading the Major Qualifying Project (MQP) at WPI in partnership with HeadVantage, focused on developing a concussion detection helmet system for contact sports.
highlights: Designing and prototyping sensor-integrated helmet hardware
Collaborating with industry partner to bring research toward a market-ready product

experience.description: Completed WPI's Interactive Qualifying Project, a research-driven project at the intersection of technology and society.

projects.title: Concussion Detection Helmet
projects.description: Designed and developed a sensor-integrated helmet system for detecting concussions in real time during contact sports. MQP project in partnership with HeadVantage.

projects.title: Autonomous Fruit-Picking Robot
projects.description: Built an autonomous robot capable of identifying and harvesting fruit using computer vision and a custom end-effector. Designed mechanical systems and programmed motion planning.

projects.title: Navigating Robot
projects.description: Developed an autonomous navigating robot capable of mapping and traversing an environment. Implemented sensor fusion and path planning algorithms.
